# CAD toolchain -- only needed to REGENERATE the STEP/STL/preview files.
# The generated files in cad/step, cad/stl, cad/previews are committed, so you
# can open/print them without installing any of this.
cadquery>=2.4     # parametric CAD, exports STEP + STL (built on OpenCASCADE)
trimesh>=4.0      # loads STL for the preview renderer
numpy>=1.24       # geometry + preview shading
matplotlib>=3.7   # renders the preview PNGs (headless / Agg)
